Tools that work on the configuration file without starting the server. check reports every problem a start would refuse or warn about.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd config [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |
